key_findings: The program targets 135 minutes of tutoring per week, which exceeds the high-dosage threshold of 90 min/week associated with roughly twice the effect size in the referenced research.
Program-wide attendance of 80.9% places the cohort just above the 80% attendance goal, meaning most students are receiving close to the intended dosage.

IEP students attend at 68.4% — well below the 80% minimum that Vaughn et al. identify as necessary to realize the full intensive-intervention effect — making IEP attendance the most actionable predictor of subgroup effectiveness.
limitations: The research references cited (R1, R10) were conducted in different program contexts; effect-size estimates may not transfer directly to this cohort's demographic and instructional configuration.
Dosage is measured in minutes per week as reported in program_context.json; actual instructional time within sessions may vary and is not captured in the available data.
This analysis ranks predictors based on alignment between local data and cited benchmarks, not on a causal model fitted to this program's outcomes.
